_comment: Catalog for the prompt builder. Data, not code: adding an action is an edit
here and needs no release. Each action carries a beat sheet rather than a
sentence - LTX responds to a timeline, and 'they kiss' produces a still
image with a wobble where '0-2s ... 2-5s ...' produces motion.
'needs' declares what the action assumes about the picture, so the builder
can warn instead of generating something incoherent.

actions.label: Kissing
beats: they turn toward each other, eyes meeting
they lean in slowly, hands finding waist and jaw
they kiss, unhurried, then part just enough to breathe

actions.label: Undressing
beats: she holds the camera's eye, one hand at a strap
the strap slides from her shoulder, fabric giving way
the garment falls, she settles into stillness

actions.label: Embrace
beats: one steps in close
arms fold around, heads resting together
they hold, breathing together, small settling movements

actions.label: Walks toward camera
beats: she takes the first step, weight shifting
she walks toward the lens, hair and clothing moving with her
she stops close to the camera, holding the look

actions.label: Turns around
beats: she begins to turn, shoulders leading
she rotates away, revealing her back
she glances back over her shoulder

actions.label: Hair and fabric in wind
beats: a first gust lifts loose strands
hair and fabric stream sideways, catching the light
the wind eases and everything settles

actions.label: Camera pushes in
beats: the camera begins a slow push forward
the frame tightens steadily, background compressing
it settles into a close hold

actions.label: Camera orbits
beats: the camera starts to arc around her
it travels, parallax opening up the background
it comes to rest on the far side
